svg.title: RMR-CB-DECK-BASE DECK PLATE, BASE
svg.text: VIEW AS IN THE DXF, SCALE 1:2
DIMENSIONS IN MILLIMETERS; THIS DRAWING GOVERNS. THE PLATE IS NOMINALLY 457.0 X 342.9 (EDGES: NOTE 3). IN INCHES: DRAWING
MAKE FROM deck_base_plate.dxf (MILLIMETERS, LAYER CUT, IN THE FRAME OF THIS VIEW) BY ANY PROCESS THAT HOLDS THE TOLERANCES:
CNC PUNCH, LASER, WATERJET OR MILL. THE FILE'S HOLES AND SLOTS ARE AT THEIR LEAST SIZE AND ITS OUTLINE AT ITS LARGEST:
OFFSET THE CUT INTO THE TOLERANCES. REPORT ANY DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE FILE AND THIS DRAWING BEFORE CUTTING.
DATUMS: THE CENTERS OF HOLES A1 (X 10.00, Y 10.00) AND A3 (Y 10.00). MEASURE EVERY CENTER AND EDGE FROM THEM, NOT FROM THE
CUT EDGES. EACH EDGE LIES ON ITS NOMINAL LINE OR UP TO 0.5 INSIDE IT, NEVER OUTSIDE.
ALL HOLES AND SLOTS THRU. DEBURR EVERY EDGE, HOLE AND SLOT ON BOTH FACES.
NO ANODIZE, PAINT OR COATING: THE PLATE IS BONDED TO PROTECTIVE EARTH THROUGH ITS BARE METAL.
MARK THE PART NUMBER "RMR-CB-DECK-BASE REV A" IN PERMANENT INK ON THE FACE SHOWN, NEAR THE ORIGIN.
THE CUSTOMER MAY SUPPLY THE MATERIAL AS ONE 18 X 24 IN SHEET OF 5052: USE IT AS SUPPLIED, NO CERTIFICATE NEEDED. CUT THE
PLATE FROM ONE CORNER AND RETURN THE REST IN ONE PIECE: THE LOWER BACK PANEL, 342.9 X 87.6, IS CUT FROM IT LATER.
FOR ASSEMBLY: THE VIEW SHOWS THE UNDERSIDE AS INSTALLED (SEE THE EDGE LABELS). THE HOLES FOR THE DIN RAILS, DUCTS AND GROUND
BARS ARE DRILLED AT ASSEMBLY (SHEET 4); A5, THE PE STUD, IS THE FIRST SCREW OF A GROUND BAR.
X, Y: CENTER FROM THE ORIGIN 0, 0, THE NOMINAL LOWER LEFT CORNER.
AL 5052-H32 SHEET, 0.063 IN (1.59 MM), ASTM B209
NONE, MILL FINISH: NO ANODIZE, PAINT OR COATING
Made by tools/draw_wiring.py (BuildShopPlate, PlateGeom) in Robot-MakingRobot: change the generator, not this sheet.
